% RQ3 per-validator stacked-bar figure (Phase 43 Plan 04, REQ-V263-03 / D-09).
% Generated by transarc-emp/src/paper/rq3_table.py.
% Two validator rows: \entValidator{} and \corefValidator{} (D-10).
\begin{figure}[t]
\centering
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  tpk/.style={fill=darkorange,draw=black!70}, % TP killed -- bad
  fpk/.style={fill=darkgreen,draw=black!70},  % FP killed -- good
  tpw/.style={fill=darkgreen!40,draw=black!70},% TP kept  -- good
  fpw/.style={fill=darkorange!40,draw=black!70},% FP kept -- bad (residual noise)
  vlabel/.style={font=\scriptsize,anchor=east},
  axn/.style={font=\tiny,gray!60},
  ax/.style={draw=black!50,thick},
]
\def\H{0.7}\def\maxw{2.6}\def\bh{0.30}\def\maxct{148}

\foreach \row/\vname/\tpk/\fpk/\tpw/\fpw in {%
  0/\entValidator{}/11/26/146/2,%
  1/\corefValidator{}/2/23/49/12%
} {
  \node[vlabel] at (-\maxw - 0.2, -\H*\row) {\vname};
  % left (killed): stack tpk above fpk, leftward from 0
  \pgfmathsetmacro{\wA}{-\tpk*\maxw/\maxct}
  \pgfmathsetmacro{\wB}{\wA - \fpk*\maxw/\maxct}
  \draw[tpk] (0,-\H*\row - \bh/2) rectangle (\wA,-\H*\row + \bh/2);
  \draw[fpk] (\wA,-\H*\row - \bh/2) rectangle (\wB,-\H*\row + \bh/2);
  % right (kept): stack tpw above fpw, rightward from 0
  \pgfmathsetmacro{\wC}{\tpw*\maxw/\maxct}
  \pgfmathsetmacro{\wD}{\wC + \fpw*\maxw/\maxct}
  \draw[tpw] (0,-\H*\row - \bh/2) rectangle (\wC,-\H*\row + \bh/2);
  \draw[fpw] (\wC,-\H*\row - \bh/2) rectangle (\wD,-\H*\row + \bh/2);
}

% center split line + outer axes (axis extended over 2 validator rows)
\draw[ax] (0,0.4) -- (0,-\H*2);
\node[font=\scriptsize,anchor=south] at (-\maxw/2, 0.45) {killed};
\node[font=\scriptsize,anchor=south] at ( \maxw/2, 0.45) {kept};

% legend
\foreach \i/\sty/\lab in {0/tpk/{TP killed (cost)}, 1/fpk/{FP killed (benefit)}, 2/tpw/{TP kept}, 3/fpw/{FP kept (noise)}} {
  \node[\sty,minimum width=8pt,minimum height=6pt,inner sep=0pt]
       at (-\maxw + \i*1.6 - 0.1, -\H*2.6) {};
  \node[anchor=west,font=\tiny] at (-\maxw + \i*1.6 + 0.05, -\H*2.6) {\lab};
}
\end{tikzpicture}
\caption{Per-validator contribution measured from the \fullVariant{} \approach{} pipeline (GPT-5.4 backend, appendix mirror; see \autoref{fig:rq3-validator}). Bars left of the centre line are links the validator \emph{rejected}; right of the centre are links it \emph{kept}. Green = correct decision, orange = wrong decision.}
\label{fig:rq3-validator-gpt}
\end{figure}
